rows.speaker: LOUDSPEAKER
rows.hi: "लल्लन की मिठाई में आधी चीनी, आधी चालाकी!"
rows.text: ଲଲ୍ଲନ ମିଠାରେ ଅଧା ଚିନି, ଆଉ ଅଧା ଚାଲାକି!
rows.back_en: In Lallan's sweets, half is sugar, and half is cunningness!

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: अरे! ये किसने बोला?
rows.text: ଆରେ! ଏଇଟା କିଏ କହିଲା?
rows.back_en: Hey! Who said this?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: मैं तो… मैं तो बस मन में सोच रहा था!
rows.text: ମୁଁ ତ... ମୁଁ ତ ଖାଲି ମନରେ ଭାବୁଥିଲି!
rows.back_en: I was... I was just thinking in my mind!

rows.speaker: TITLE CARD
rows.hi: सुबह — मेले से पहले
rows.text: ସକାଳ — ମେଳା ପୂର୍ବରୁ
rows.back_en: Morning — Before the fair

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: चाचा! आज कौन-सी मशीन बना रहे हो?
rows.text: ଦାଦା! ଆଜି କୋଉ ମେସିନ୍ ବନାଉଛନ୍ତି?
rows.back_en: Dada! What machine are you making today?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: ये है… "दिल की बात रेडियो"! जिसकी तरफ़ घुमाओ, उसके दिल की आवाज़ सुनाई देगी।
rows.text: ଏଇଟା ହେଲା... "ମନ କଥା ରେଡିଓ"! ଯାହା ଆଡ଼କୁ ବୁଲେଇବ, ତାର ମନ କଥା ଶୁଭାଯିବ।
rows.back_en: This is... the "Mind Talk Radio"! Whomever you point it at, their inner thoughts will be heard.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दिल की आवाज़? चाचा, दिल तो धक-धक करता है, बात थोड़ी करता है!
rows.text: ମନ କଥା? ଦାଦା, ଛାତି ତ ଧକ୍-ଧକ୍ କରେ, କଥା କ'ଣ କହେ କି!
rows.back_en: Inner thoughts? Dada, the chest just beats thump-thump, does it even speak?!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: करता है, बिटिया। बस कोई सुनता नहीं।
rows.text: କହେ ରେ ମାଆ। ଖାଲି କେହି ଶୁଣନ୍ତିନି।
rows.back_en: It does, child. Just that nobody listens.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: देखो! पहला टेस्ट — शेरू!
rows.text: ଦେଖ! ପ୍ରଥମ ପରୀକ୍ଷା — ଶେରୁ!
rows.back_en: Look! The first test — Sheru!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: मुझे भी लड्डू चाहिए! एक नहीं, दो!
rows.text: ମୋତେ ବି ଲଡୁ ଦରକାର! ଗୋଟେ ନୁହେଁ, ଦୁଇଟା!
rows.back_en: I want laddus too! Not one, two!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: हाहाहा! चाचा, ये तो सच में काम करता है!
rows.text: ହାହାହା! ଦାଦା, ଏଇଟା ତ ସତରେ କାମ କରୁଛି!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! Dada, this is really working!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: पर ध्यान रहे, अभी ये पूरी तरह तैयार नहीं है। इसे कोई बाहर नहीं ले जाएगा!
rows.text: ହେଲେ ମନେ ଥାଉ, ଏଇଟା ଏବେ ପୂରା ତିଆରି ହେଇନି। ବାହାରକୁ କେହି ନେବନି!
rows.back_en: But remember, this is not fully ready yet. No one should take it outside!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बिल्कुल नहीं, चाचा!
rows.text: ଜମାରୁ ନାହିଁ, ଦାଦା!
rows.back_en: Not at all, Dada!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: बस थोड़ी देर के लिए…
rows.text: ଖାଲି ଟିକିଏ ସମୟ ପାଇଁ...
rows.back_en: Just for a little while...

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: मेले में बड़ा मज़ा आएगा!
rows.text: ମେଳାରେ ଭାରି ମଜା ହବ!
rows.back_en: It will be so much fun at the fair!

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: देखो मेरी पतंग! पूरे गाँव में सबसे ऊँची उड़ेगी!
rows.text: ଦେଖ ମୋ ଗୁଡ଼ି! ସାରା ଗାଁରେ ସବୁଠୁ ଉପରେ ଉଡ଼ିବ!
rows.back_en: Look at my kite! It will fly the highest in the entire village!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: अच्छा? रेडियो, ज़रा राजू के दिल की सुनाओ!
rows.text: ହଉ କି? ରେଡିଓ, ଟିକେ ରାଜୁ ମନର କଥା ଶୁଣାଅ!
rows.back_en: Is that so? Radio, let us hear what's in Raju's mind!

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: गुड़िया मुझसे अच्छी पतंग उड़ाती है… पर ये मैं कभी नहीं मानूँगा!
rows.text: ଗୁଡ଼ିଆ ମୋଠୁ ଭଲ ଗୁଡ଼ି ଉଡ଼ାଏ... ହେଲେ ଏ କଥା ମୁଁ କେବେ ମାନିବିନି!
rows.back_en: Gudia flies kites better than me... but I will never admit this!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: हाँ! सुना सबने?
rows.text: ହଁ! ଶୁଣିଲ ତ ସମସ୍ତେ?
rows.back_en: Yes! Did everyone hear that?

rows.speaker: RAJU
rows.hi: अरे! ये… ये तो झूठी मशीन है!
rows.text: ଆରେ! ଏଇଟା... ଏଇଟା ମିଛ ମେସିନ୍ ଗୋଟାଏ!
rows.back_en: Hey! This... this is a fake machine!

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: बच्चो, कल स्कूल समय पर आना। अनुशासन बहुत ज़रूरी है।
rows.text: ପିଲାମାନେ, କାଲି ସ୍କୁଲ ଠିକ୍ ସମୟରେ ଆସିବ। ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳା ବହୁତ ଜରୁରୀ।
rows.back_en: Children, come to school on time tomorrow. Discipline is very important.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: काश कल भी छुट्टी होती… और मैं दिन भर सोता रहता।
rows.text: କାଲି ବି ଟିକେ ଛୁଟି ଥାଆନ୍ତା କି... ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଦିନସାରା ଶୋଇଥାଆନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: Wish tomorrow was also a holiday... and I could sleep all day.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: ये… ये किसकी आवाज़ है?
rows.text: ଏଇଟା... ଏଇଟା କାହାର ସ୍ୱର?
rows.back_en: This... whose voice is this?

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: वो रहे! उनके हाथ में कोई जादुई डिब्बा है!
rows.text: ସେଇଠି ଅଛନ୍ତି! ତାଙ୍କ ହାତରେ କୋଉ ଯାଦୁ ଡବାଟାଏ ଅଛି!
rows.back_en: They are right there! There is some magic box in their hands!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: भागो!
rows.text: ଦୌଡ଼!
rows.back_en: Run!

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: रुको! वो अभी तैयार नहीं है!
rows.text: ରୁହ! ସେଇଟା ଏବେ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ହେଇନି!
rows.back_en: Wait! That is not ready yet!

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: बच गए!
rows.text: ବଞ୍ଚିଗଲେ!
rows.back_en: We're saved!

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: लल्लन चाचा का चेहरा देखा था?
rows.text: ଲଲ୍ଲନ ଦାଦାଙ୍କ ମୁହଁ ଦେଖିଥିଲୁ?
rows.back_en: Did you see Lallan Dada's face?

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: सब बड़े हो गए… अब कोई कहानी सुनने नहीं आता।
rows.text: ସମସ୍ତେ ବଡ଼ ହେଇଗଲେ... ଏବେ କେହି ଗପ ଶୁଣିବାକୁ ଆସୁନାହାନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: Everyone grew up... now no one comes to listen to stories.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: आज भी बच्चों के लिए लड्डू बनाए थे… पर कोई आया ही नहीं।
rows.text: ଆଜି ବି ପିଲାଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଲଡୁ ବନେଇଥିଲି... ହେଲେ କେହି ଆସିଲେ ହିଁ ନାହିଁ।
rows.back_en: Today too I made laddus for the children... but no one came at all.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी… अकेली बैठी हैं।
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା... ଏକା ବସିଛନ୍ତି।
rows.back_en: Grandmother... is sitting alone.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सुबह दादी ने बुलाया था… मैंने कहा, "बाद में, दादी।"
rows.text: ସକାଳେ ଜେଜେମା ଡାକୁଥିଲେ... ମୁଁ କହିଲି, "ପରେ ଯିବି, ଜେଜେମା।"
rows.back_en: In the morning Grandmother was calling... I said, "I'll go later, Grandmother."

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: हम सब मेले में थे… और दादी यहाँ अकेली।
rows.text: ଆମେ ସବୁ ମେଳାରେ ଥିଲୁ... ଆଉ ଜେଜେମା ଏଠି ଏକାକୀ।
rows.back_en: We were all at the fair... and Grandmother is here all alone.

rows.speaker: MASTERJI
rows.hi: सच ही कहा था रेडियो ने।
rows.text: ସତ ହିଁ କହୁଥିଲା ରେଡିଓଟା।
rows.back_en: The radio was actually telling the truth.

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: कुछ बातें रेडियो से नहीं… पास बैठने से सुनाई देती हैं।
rows.text: କିଛି କଥା ରେଡିଓରୁ ନୁହେଁ... ପାଖରେ ବସିଲେ ହିଁ ଶୁଭାଯାଏ।
rows.back_en: Some things are not heard from a radio... they are only heard when sitting close by.

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: दादी! मेला हम आपके पास ले आए!
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା! ମେଳାକୁ ଆମେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ପାଖକୁ ନେଇଆସିଲୁ!
rows.back_en: Grandmother! We brought the fair to you!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे! तुम सब यहाँ? मेला छोड़कर?
rows.text: ଆରେ! ତମେ ସବୁ ଏଠି? ମେଳା ଛାଡ଼ିକି?
rows.back_en: Oh! You are all here? Leaving the fair?

rows.speaker: CHHOTU
rows.hi: सॉरी दादी। सुबह आपने बुलाया था और मैं नहीं आया।
rows.text: ସରି ଜେଜେମା। ସକାଳେ ତମେ ଡାକିଥିଲ ଆଉ ମୁଁ ଆସିଲିନି।
rows.back_en: Sorry Grandmother. You called in the morning and I didn't come.

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: अरे पगले… तू आ गया, यही बहुत है।
rows.text: ଆରେ ବାୟା... ତୁ ଆସିଗଲୁ, ଏଇୟା ବହୁତ।
rows.back_en: Oh silly child... you came, that is more than enough.

rows.speaker: GUDIYA
rows.hi: दादी, कहानी सुनाइए ना!
rows.text: ଜେଜେମା, ଗପଟେ କୁହନ୍ତୁ ନା!
rows.back_en: Grandmother, tell us a story, please!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: तो सुनो… मेरी पहली दिवाली की कहानी। तब इस गाँव में बिजली भी नहीं थी…
rows.text: ତେବେ ଶୁଣ... ମୋ ପ୍ରଥମ ଦୀପାବଳିର କଥା। ସେତେବେଳେ ଏ ଗାଁରେ ବିଜୁଳି ବି ନଥିଲା...
rows.back_en: Then listen... the story of my first Diwali. Back then, there wasn't even electricity in this village...

rows.speaker: LALLAN
rows.hi: और ये लीजिए दादी — मेरी मिठाई। आज पूरी चीनी वाली!
rows.text: ଆଉ ଏଇଟା ନିଅନ୍ତୁ ଜେଜେମା — ମୋ ମିଠା। ଆଜି ପୂରା ଚିନି ଥିବା ମିଠା!
rows.back_en: And take this, Grandmother — my sweet. Today it's a sweet with full sugar!

rows.speaker: EVERYONE
rows.hi: हाहाहा!
rows.text: ହାହାହା!
rows.back_en: Hahaha!

rows.speaker: DADI
rows.hi: बच्चो, दिवाली दीयों से नहीं… अपनों के साथ बैठने से रोशन होती है।
rows.text: ପିଲାମାନେ, ଦୀପାବଳି ଦୀପରେ ନୁହେଁ... ନିଜ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ବସିଲେ ଆଲୋକିତ ହୁଏ।
rows.back_en: Children, Diwali is not lit by lamps... it shines when sitting with our loved ones.

rows.speaker: RADIO
rows.hi: अब तो लड्डू मिलेगा?
rows.text: ଏବେ ତ ଲଡୁ ମିଳିବ?
rows.back_en: Will I get a laddu now?

rows.speaker: JUGAADU CHACHA
rows.hi: हाहाहा! इसका तो पक्का मिलेगा!
rows.text: ହାହାହା! ଏୟାକୁ ତ ନିଶ୍ଚୟ ମିଳିବ!
rows.back_en: Hahaha! This one will definitely get one!

rows.speaker: END CARD
rows.hi: बड़ों के साथ समय बिताओ — उन्हें हमारी उतनी ही ज़रूरत है जितनी हमें उनकी।
rows.text: ବଡ଼ମାନଙ୍କ ସହ ସମୟ ବିତାନ୍ତୁ — ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଆମର ସେତିକି ଦରକାର ଯେତିକି ଆମକୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର।
rows.back_en: Spend time with elders — they need us as much as we need them.
